text:
emma (Marketing Lead): Quick sync — we're prepping customer-facing updates for the inference latency incident in us-west. Need: status-page copy, comms timing (email + in-app), and any segment-specific notes. Can SRE confirm scope & current ETA?
ryan (SRE): Scope: hosted API in us-west, increased tail latency for generation endpoints and occasional 503s. No data loss. Root cause suspected GPU driver regression during autoscale. Investigating rollback window.
emma (Marketing Lead): thanks. i'll draft two short variants for status page (concise vs detailed). also thinking about when to send an email — initial status page now, then email to affected customers once we have mitigation plan? thoughts. :thinking_face:
matt (Product): include workaround: reduce max_tokens or early stopping to avoid longer sequences for now. that'll help some users. Also flag any Dedicated customers separately.
sara (Customer Success): +1 on segmenting. High-touch accounts (Dedicated + named enterprise) should get direct outreach from CS within 30m of initial update. Can we get a list from alerts-bot?
alerts-bot: Automated alert: 1761204720 — elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west. Affected customers: 18 accounts with >1rps.
josh (Legal): Quick note on wording: avoid absolute ETA promises and don't imply SLA breaches until postmortem confirms. "Investigating" + "working on mitigation" is safer than firm timelines.
emma (Marketing Lead): agreed. Drafts below — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or suggest edits.
---
Proposed status (concise):
"We are investigating increased inference latency and intermittent errors affecting the hosted API in the US‑West region. Engineers are actively working on mitigation. There is no evidence of data loss. We will provide updates here and to affected customers via email."
---
Proposed status (detailed):
"At 09:45 UTC we observed elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx responses for the generation endpoints in US‑West. Our SRE team has identified a likely regression in the GPU driver during autoscale; engineers are validating a rollback and mitigation plan. No customer data appears impacted. Temporary workarounds: reduce max_tokens or early stop. Updates will be posted hourly and via email to affected customers. High-touch accounts will receive direct outreach."
---
ryan (SRE): tweak: change "likely regression" to "suspected regression" and remove ETA commitments. otherwise OK. We'll confirm rollback window in ~25m.
emma (Marketing Lead): updated detailed variant with "suspected regression" and hourly update cadence. Proposed comms timing: post status page now, first email to affected customers 60m after confirmed mitigation or if we have a concrete rollback plan earlier. Sara — CS does direct outreach in parallel for top 10 accounts?
sara (Customer Success): yes — CS will start outreach now to let them know we're investigating and we'll follow up with specifics. For the tiered email: send a shorter 'we're aware and investigating' to all users, and a detailed note to the affected list.
matt (Product): also prod note: pause any scheduled marketing sends targeted at developer lists for next 6h.
emma (Marketing Lead): noted — pausing scheduled sends. josh — legal ok with updated copy?
josh (Legal): LGTM given edits. one ask: include "postmortem will be published" only after incident classification confirmed.
emma (Marketing Lead): got it. final action items: post status page (marketing) — now; SRE to update rollback decision by 1761205100; CS outreach to top accounts — now; marketing pause sends — now; email draft (marketing) prepared and will send to affected list after rollback confirmation or at 60m. i'll post final approved copy here when ready. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
